meaning_en: to bake bread loaves in oven

past.ar: خَبَزَ الخَبَّازُ رَقَائِقَ الحِنْطَةِ فِي التَّنُّورِ
past.de: Der Bäcker backte die Weizenfladen im Lehmofen
past.en: The baker baked the wheat loaves inside the tannur

present.ar: يَخْبِزُ الأَرْغِفَةَ لِتَكُونَ هَشَّةً ذَكِيَّةَ الرَّائِحَةِ
present.de: Er backt die Fladen knusprig und duftend aus
present.en: He bakes the loaves so they turn crisp and aromatic

imperative.ar: اخْبِزْ بِحَرَارَةٍ مُعْتَدِلَةٍ تَحْفَظُ لِينَ اللُّبِّ
imperative.de: Backe bei mäßiger Hitze, die die Krume saftig hält!
imperative.en: Bake with moderate heat that preserves crumb tenderness!
